result.summary: The interface appears to be a design mockup using placeholder assets and exhibits minor layout and accessibility issues.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used instead of actual food photography, making the app look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder vectors with high-quality, appetite-appealing restaurant images.

issues.description: Text for delivery fees and times has insufficient color contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text colors to improve legibility for all users.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons are positioned too close to the system home gesture indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to provide adequate clearance from OS-level controls.

issues.description: Category chips are clipped at the screen edge without a clear visual cue for horizontal scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Introduce a subtle edge fade or adjust spacing to signal scrollable content.
